beforeFix.initialFixtureCorrection: The initial assertion read a critical event through the intentionally filtered HUD feed. It now reads the actual simulation event list; the UI must use authoritative live criticalFronts rather than require a visible historical event.

scope: Real simulation loss expiry names only expired fronts, separately tracked after recovery, checkpoint and pause.
Captured plain-data cause and front names survive mutation and disposal of the simulation.
Earliest live critical deadline controls the warning location, independently of the newest event or intel filtering.
Direction chooses the surviving co-op hunter when player1 is defeated.
Actual simulation operation_timeout and objectives_completed reasons map to their appropriate French result text.
limitations: No browser, natural mission victory, human playtest, hardware performance or 1:1 appearance validation in this component pass.
Narrative objective_lost:<id> and convoy_escaped:<id> still use the generic defeat fallback; they are outside the critical-front criterion.
AUD047 awaits integrated browser end-screen evidence and global release checks before closure.
